sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default when a value is absent — the act of substituting something for nothing.
sketches.resonance: When you reach for what someone promised and find Nothing, you must supply your own meaning to go on.
sketches.draft:
module WhatYouPromised where

import Data.Maybe

promised :: Maybe a
promised = Nothing

kept :: a -> a
kept self = fromMaybe self promised

sketches.mechanism: The sealed class hierarchy with 'when' exhaustive matching — the compiler forces you to handle every possibility, including the one you want to ignore.
sketches.resonance: Grief demands you face every form it takes; the compiler, like time, will not let you skip the ones that hurt.

sketches.mechanism: A descriptor's __set_name__ is called once when the class is created, permanently binding a name to the attribute — a name given at birth that the object itself never chose.
sketches.resonance: You carry the name they gave you before you existed, written into your definition, impossible to refuse.
